title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
summary: Orphaned Mary Lennox is sent from India to a gloomy Yorkshire manor. There she discovers a locked garden, a hidden cousin and a way to make something grow.
readIf: you want a gentle, restorative classic about nature, friendship and healing.
skipIf: you dislike period dialect, which appears in some of the dialogue.

pairings.reason: Another classic about a lonely girl transformed by a new home and a love of the outdoors.
Similar in how mountain air, nature and kindness change a child and those around her.
Another children's classic about children discovering a hidden world, with more magic and adventure.
